entradas.text: "I'd like to begin by giving President Rayne a chance to speak about his decision to form a new party."
"On to the next question."
"The USP is stuck in the past. I founded a new party to turn Sordland into the modern, competitive nation it is destined to become."
entradas.menu: "The USP is stuck in the past. I founded a new party to turn Sordland into the modern, competitive nation it is destined to become."

entradas.text: "What exactly does the Democrat Party have to offer that the USP did not?"
"What exactly does the Liberal Party have to offer that the USP did not?"
"What exactly does the Maroon Party have to offer that the USP did not?"
"What exactly does the Sordish Prosperity Party have to offer that the USP did not?"
"My new party is a chance to return Sordland to its Sollist roots. The Colonel of 20 years ago would not recognize what the USP has become today."
entradas.menu: "My new party is a chance to return Sordland to its Sollist roots. The Colonel of 20 years ago would not recognize what the USP has become today."

entradas.text: "The USP has forgotten who it serves: the Sordish people. With my new party, everyone will have a voice."
entradas.menu: "The USP has forgotten who it serves: the Sordish people. With my new party, everyone will have a voice."

entradas.text: "The USP has forgotten what the 'S' in its name stands for. My new party will put Sordland first."
entradas.menu: "The USP has forgotten what the 'S' in its name stands for. My new party will put Sordland first."

entradas.text: "In a word, money. The USP has had a chokehold on the economy for too long. It's time to give Sordish businesses a chance to thrive."
entradas.menu: "In a word, money. The USP has had a chokehold on the economy for too long. It's time to give Sordish businesses a chance to thrive."

entradas.text: The moderator motioned for silence.
"Spoken like a true puppet of the Oligarchs."
"What exactly does the People's Party have to offer that the USP did not?"
"By nationalizing them, you mean? Ridiculous!"
"How can you possibly say that after what you did to him?"
"Preposterous. Any follower of Soll would stay true to the party he founded."
"Any true Sordish patriot would have joined the NFP. You're in this for yourself, Rayne."
"Your allegiances show where your petty priorities lie. This is not about the rise of the Sordish people but your own individual ego, Rayne."
"Ah, so you eliminated the NFP leadership so you could take on its values for yourself."
"I can be proud of my country without being a bigot."
entradas.menu: "I can be proud of my country without being a bigot."

entradas.text: "The NFP doesn't think big enough. My party will crush all of Sordland's enemies."
entradas.menu: "The NFP doesn't think big enough. My party will crush all of Sordland's enemies."

entradas.text: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the NFP."
entradas.menu: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the NFP."

entradas.text: "I'm prepared to ally with the NFP."
entradas.menu: "I'm prepared to ally with the NFP."

entradas.text: "I liked Soll's ideas. Not the man himself."
entradas.menu: "I liked Soll's ideas. Not the man himself."

entradas.text: "Not after the way I was betrayed."
entradas.menu: "Not after the way I was betrayed."

entradas.text: "No. It's time to take his ideas and bring them into our modern age."
entradas.menu: "No. It's time to take his ideas and bring them into our modern age."

entradas.text: "Honestly, I just couldn't stomach the thought of you as president."
entradas.menu: "Honestly, I just couldn't stomach the thought of you as president."

entradas.text: "Soll betrayed his own ideals. He had to go."
entradas.menu: "Soll betrayed his own ideals. He had to go."

entradas.text: "If you really wanted Sordland to have a chance at democracy, you would have endorsed the PFJP after your Congress loss."
"If you really wanted Sordland to have a chance at democracy, you would have endorsed the PFJP after your Congress loss."
"Ah, so you eliminated the PFJP leadership so you could take on its values for yourself."
"To be honest, I just plain don't like the PFJP."
entradas.menu: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the PFJP."

entradas.text: "I'm prepared to ally with the PFJP."
entradas.menu: "I'm prepared to ally with the PFJP."

entradas.text: "No, the PFJP is too capitalist for my tastes."
entradas.menu: "No, the PFJP is too capitalist for my tastes."

entradas.text: "The PFJP is too globalist for me. I want to keep the focus on Sordland."
entradas.menu: "The PFJP is too globalist for me. I want to keep the focus on Sordland."

entradas.text: "The USP cannot admit that Malenyev had the right idea. My party will finally bring communism to Sordland:"
entradas.menu: "The USP cannot admit that Malenyev had the right idea. My party will finally bring communism to Sordland:"

entradas.text: "Any true communist would have joined the Communist Party. You're in this for yourself, President Rayne."
"I'm prepared to ally with the Communist Party."
entradas.menu: "I'm prepared to ally with the Communist Party."

entradas.text: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the Communist Party."
entradas.menu: "To be honest, I just plain don't like the Communist Party."

entradas.text: "Your party is too radical, Stahler. I'm willing to make compromises to achieve our goals."
entradas.menu: "Your party is too radical, Stahler. I'm willing to make compromises to achieve our goals."

entradas.text: "Any true communist would not have gone against Leon Malenyev."
entradas.menu: "Any true communist would not have gone against Leon Malenyev."

entradas.text: "No, you founded it because you could not admit you had lost."
"I'm so happy I don't have to put up with another four years of you."
entradas.menu: "I'm so happy I don't have to put up with another four years of you."

entradas.text: "I still respect you, Lileas. I had hoped we could settle this like adults."
entradas.menu: "I still respect you, Lileas. I had hoped we could settle this like adults."

entradas.text: "I was happy to lose. It gave me the excuse to do what I'd wanted to for years."
entradas.menu: "I was happy to lose. It gave me the excuse to do what I'd wanted to for years."

entradas.text: "That was the initial reason, yes. But I've had time to develop my platform."
entradas.menu: "That was the initial reason, yes. But I've had time to develop my platform."

entradas.text: "That doesn't change the fact that--"
"But if you really pay attention to what Marcia said--"
"Then you've just lost yourself an ally. In fact--"
"Not now. It's too risky."
"Never. Not after what happened to--"
"Fair enough. There's room in the Assembly for both our parties. In fact--"
"Fair enough. There's room in the Assembly for both our parties. In fact--"
"At last, something we agree on."
"Not now. It's too risky."
"Never. Not after what happened to--"
"I'm going to enjoy crushing you at the polls."
"You were such a bright boy, President Rayne. What happened?"
"Come over here and say that to my face. I doubt that you have the same will as we do."
"Such crude language, Mr. President."
"A valid sentiment."
"With my help, you could have. You don't have a prayer now."
"Not if we crush you with our iron will first."
"Big ambitions for such a unimaginative party."
"You traitor!"
"Saving one's own party is hardly a 'betrayal' --"
"All this talk of modernity, yet you--"
"The feeling is mutual."
"By nationalizing them, you mean? Ridiculous!"
